title: Korean Kisseled Dessert
description: A unique dessert combining the sweetness of raspberries with the nutty and kissed flavors. Perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: Combine raspberries, honey, and sugar in a blender and mix until smooth.
Heat the mixture over medium heat until the sugar dissolves.
Add the nutty sesame seeds and kissed pecans to the mixture and stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Serve chilled and garnish with additional raspberries and sesame seeds if desired.
